extDescription.message: Rendered Markdown diffs in GitHub pull requests: see only the changed parts and comment right on them.

titleOn.message: Markdown Diff Cat: on (click to turn off)

titleOff.message: Markdown Diff Cat: off (click to turn on)

titleProblem.message: Markdown Diff Cat: could not read the page — $WHAT$

commentAddHint.message: Click to comment on this block. Drag to another block to comment on a range.

pendingHint.message: Only you can see this until you submit your review with “Review changes” at the top. Reload the page if the count there has not changed.

threadsUnplaced.message: Comments on lines this view does not show

threadsUnavailable.message: This file has review comments that could not be shown here.

errorLineNotResolved.message: GitHub did not accept a comment on this line. Comment on a changed line nearby, or use the source diff.

errorStale.message: This pull request has new commits. Reload the page and try again.

problemComments.message: commenting is off — GitHub changed the requests its page uses

errorChanged.message: GitHub changed how comments are posted, so this one was not posted. Your text is still here: copy it and comment from the source diff (<>).
